title: Beyond Detection: Unveiling Fairness Vulnerabilities in Abusive Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Demographic Parity difference (ΔDP) and Equal Opportunity difference (ΔEO) on the Jigsaw Toxicity dataset to assess the performance gap between Black and White demographic groups under targeted adversarial backdoor attacks.

Measuring Demographic Parity difference (ΔDP) and Equal Opportunity difference (ΔEO) on the Sexist Tweets dataset to assess the performance gap between male and female demographic groups under targeted adversarial backdoor attacks.
